text:
```yaml
name: Codex Docs Speech Hygiene Clean

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'

jobs:
  codex-clean:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed docs files
        id: changed
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          separator: "\n"

      - name: Run Codex to clean speech hygiene
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        uses: openai/codex-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            Clean speech hygiene in the following files:
            ${{ steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}
          model: gpt-4
          output-file: codex_output.txt
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
```
